title: Hudson Tuf-Lite II 4000H Series Hub | Cooling Tower Fans
description: Hudson Tuf-Lite II 4000H Series Hub fan assemblies offer years of cost effective, reliable service. Cooling Tower replacement parts from ICST.

layout.title: Hudson Tuf-Lite II 4000H Series Hub | Cooling Tower Fans

paragraphs: Adjustable Pitch Fan Assembly 15′ Through 20′ Diameter. Blade Counts from 4 to 10.

Hudson Tuf-Lite II 4000H Series Hub (White, previously Blue) fan blades are made from fiberglass-reinforced vinyl-ester resin, which offers a high strength-to-weight ratio and ultraviolet and corrosion resistance. An elastomeric blade/holder joint cover prevents moisture from entering the blade.
